Upon completion of {{Mission|Divergent Universe: Loading Equation}}, it can also be accessed in the [[Interastral Peace Guide]] through [[Interastral Peace Guide/Cosmic Strife|Cosmic Strife]].

Its currency is {{Item|Herta Bond}}.

The '''Light Cone Manifest''' is a [[Shop]] located:
* In the [[Parlor Car]] aboard the [[Astral Express]], after completing {{Mission|Fleeting Lights}}, operated by the [[Messenger]].
* In [[Exalting Sanctum]] aboard [[The Xianzhou Luofu]] after completing {{Mission|Youci's Clever Decor}}, operated by [[Youci]].
* In [[Dreamflux Reef]] in [[Penacony]]'s [[Dreamscape]] after completing {{Mission|Grim Film of Finality|showChapter=0}}, operated by [[Elegy]].
* It can also be accessed in the [[Interastral Peace Guide]] through [[Interastral Peace Guide/Treasures Lightward|Treasures Lightward]].

Its currency is {{Item|Lucent Afterglow}}.
